title: Type 2 diabetes (facts stated in the note)
hint: Every fact is stated in the note, so the model should decide each criterion correctly and cite the right sentences.
note:
0. A 54-year-old man presents for a routine diabetes follow-up.
1. He was diagnosed with type 2 diabetes mellitus six years ago.
2. He takes metformin 1000 mg twice daily.
3. His HbA1c last month was 8.1%.
4. He has no history of heart disease or kidney disease.
5. He has never smoked.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Adults aged 18 to 75 years
- Diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus
- HbA1c above 7%
Exclusion criteria:
- History of heart failure
- Chronic kidney disease

title: Asthma (facts stated in the note)
hint: Simple inclusion and exclusion facts that are explicitly written in the note.
note:
0. A 28-year-old woman presents with wheezing and shortness of breath.
1. She has had asthma since childhood.
2. She uses an albuterol inhaler about twice a week.
3. She has never smoked.
4. Her peak flow today is 78% of predicted.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Physician-diagnosed asthma
Exclusion criteria:
- Current smoker

title: Pneumonia inpatient (facts stated in the note)
hint: Numeric facts (age, temperature) and a clear 'no allergy' statement.
note:
0. A 72-year-old man is admitted with cough and fever.
1. His temperature on arrival was 39.1 C.
2. Chest X-ray shows a right lower lobe infiltrate.
3. He has no known drug allergies.
4. He lives independently.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Age over 65 years
- Fever above 38 C
- Radiographic evidence of pneumonia
Exclusion criteria:
- Known allergy to penicillin

title: Heart failure (facts stated in the note)
hint: Diagnosis and ejection fraction are stated; cancer history is explicitly denied.
note:
0. A 63-year-old woman is seen in the heart failure clinic.
1. She was diagnosed with heart failure two years ago.
2. Her most recent echocardiogram showed an ejection fraction of 30%.
3. She has no history of cancer.
4. She takes furosemide and carvedilol.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Diagnosis of heart failure
- Left ventricular ejection fraction below 40%
Exclusion criteria:
- Active cancer

title: Knee pain (information missing in the note)
hint: The note says nothing about X-ray results or BMI, so the correct answer is 'not enough information' and it should NOT invent evidence.
note:
0. A 47-year-old woman presents with knee pain.
1. The pain started three months ago and worsens when climbing stairs.
2. Examination shows mild swelling of the right knee.
3. She takes ibuprofen as needed.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Knee osteoarthritis confirmed by X-ray
- Body mass index above 30

title: Pregnancy criterion for a male patient
hint: Known weakness: the correct label is 'not applicable' but the model answers 'not excluded'.
note:
0. A 40-year-old man presents with chronic low back pain.
1. The pain has lasted for eight months.
2. He works as a delivery driver.
3. He takes naproxen when needed.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Chronic low back pain for more than 3 months
Exclusion criteria:
- Pregnancy

title: Exclusion facts never mentioned in the note
hint: Known weakness: the note never mentions vaccines, so the right answer is 'not enough information', but the model tends to say 'not excluded' (treats missing info as eligible).
note:
0. A 35-year-old man presents with recurrent migraine headaches.
1. Episodes occur about three times a month.
2. He has tried over-the-counter analgesics without relief.
3. He has no other medical problems.
criteria:
Exclusion criteria:
- Received any vaccine within the last 4 weeks
- Treatment with a monoclonal antibody in the last 6 months

title: Anticoagulant exclusion that applies
hint: Known weakness: the model almost never predicts 'excluded' (very rare in the training data), so it answers 'not excluded' even when the exclusion applies.
note:
0. A 70-year-old man has atrial fibrillation.
1. He has been taking warfarin daily for three years.
2. His INR is well controlled.
3. He also has hypertension treated with amlodipine.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Diagnosis of atrial fibrillation
Exclusion criteria:
- Current use of anticoagulant medication

title: Inclusion criteria clearly not met
hint: Known weakness: 'not included' is rare in training, so the model may over-read topical similarity.
note:
0. A 22-year-old woman presents for a sports physical.
1. She has no chronic medical conditions.
2. Her fasting glucose was normal.
3. She has no history of diabetes.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus
- Currently taking insulin
